prompt: Design an OpenMCP sequence that inspects requested changes, implements them, and verifies the implementation. The user asks for .openmcp/workflows/triage.yaml.

assertions.text: States that custom workflow files are unsupported and does not author YAML
Uses only built-in implement, review, and consult workflows
Describes an ordered job sequence with precise prompts and context keys
Uses parent_job_id only where the parent has a successful commit
Identifies the approved implementation job as the integration target
